title: CFTC Sues Cash FX Over Alleged $950M Forex Ponzi Scheme
description: The CFTC charged Cash FX Group and three individuals with running a $950 million forex Ponzi scheme that left participants at least $406 million short.

title: CleanSpark Closes $2.276B Notes Sale for Georgia Data Center
description: CleanSpark closed a $2.276 billion sale of 7.875 percent senior secured notes due 2031 to fund its Sandersville data center campus in Georgia.

title: Kalshi Loses Sixth Circuit Appeal Over Sports Contracts
description: The Sixth Circuit ruled Kalshi failed to show its sports-event contracts are swaps, letting Ohio and Tennessee enforce their gambling laws against the prediction market.

title: KelpDAO Sues LayerZero Over $292M Bridge Exploit
description: Evercrest Technologies, the company behind KelpDAO, filed suit in British Columbia against LayerZero and its CEO over the April rsETH bridge exploit.

title: SEC Commissioner Hester Peirce to Leave Post on Oct. 2
description: SEC Commissioner Hester Peirce submitted her resignation effective Oct. 2, ending an eight-year tenure that included leading the agency Crypto Task Force.
